_about: The ONE place for NSE trading holidays (equity and F&O). Every module reads this file through market_calendar.py: the loop and watchdog, the scans, Nifty expiry dates, the backtests, the digest, the readiness check and the app (via news.json). Only entries with status 'official' are applied. To add a year: copy the dates from the NSE circular 'Trading holidays for the calendar year YYYY', set status to 'official', fill source, and run python test_calendar.py.

2027.note: NSE had not published the 2027 list on 18 Nov 2026: its own 2026-27 Trade-for-Trade review calendar marks January 2027 dates 'Subject to change as per Holiday calendar for 2027'. The circular usually comes out in mid-December (2026's: 12 Dec 2025; 2024's: 12 Dec 2023). Third-party '2027 lists' disagree with each other (Holi 22 or 23 March, Muharram 15 or 16 June, Good Friday 26 March or 16 April), so none is used.
